title: SecurityPolicy
description: A bun-security policy (control-plane.md §2): a scope's own is partial, layered over the scopes above it; nothing is required. The shape only: securityPolicySchema checks the rest.

service.description: the service's name, as events and bans name it

public.description: a public service: the trust check warns when its clients resolve inside

mode.description: the whole policy's mode; default enforce

ipv6Prefix.description: an IPv6 client is keyed by this prefix; default 64

internal.description: the internal never-block list (layers.md L3.1): true (default), false, or narrowed to some of its ranges

items.description: a CIDR inside the internal ranges

lists.description: allow and deny entries (layers.md L3), keyed by `id` or their subject

items.description: an allow or deny entry (layers.md L3): exactly one subject and an action

id.description: a stable id, unique in the policy; default its subject

ip.description: an IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range

user.description: a user id (the control plane keys it on save)

apiKey.description: an API key id (the control plane keys it on save)

action.description: what a match does (required in the effective policy)

override.description: an allow that wins over a block in the same scope; default false

locked.description: lower scopes cannot override it; default false

expiresAt.description: when it stops applying, ISO 8601 with a time zone

mode.description: enforce applies it; dryRun records what it would have done; off skips it

serviceIdentity.description: sibling services allowed to call under their own identity (layers.md L2.4)

header.description: the header carrying a token; default "x-service-token"

clientIpHeader.description: the header carrying a forwarded end-user address; default "x-service-client-ip"

id.description: its name, unique in the policy

verifier.description: the SHA-256 of its token, "sha256:<64 hex>", or several during a rotation

forwardsClientIp.description: its forwarded end-user address is believed; default false

exempt.description: what a verified call skips; default all four

trustCheck.description: the trust-misconfiguration check (layers.md L2.5); false for none

anyOf.description: the trust-misconfiguration check (layers.md L2.5); false for none

threshold.description: the share of a minute's requests that marks it suspicious; default 0.5

window.description: how long before the warning; default "5m"

minRequests.description: a minute with fewer requests never counts; default 20

concurrency.description: connection and in-flight limits (layers.md L1); false for none

anyOf.description: connection and in-flight limits (layers.md L1); false for none

perIp.description: in-flight requests per client address; default 64

total.description: in-flight requests in all; none by default

releaseAfter.description: a slot held longer is released

mode.description: enforce applies it; dryRun records what it would have done; off skips it

items.description: a rate limit (layers.md L9): at most `limit` requests per `window` for one key; past it, 429

limit.description: requests allowed per window (required in the effective policy)

subSecond.description: accept a window under one second; default false

key.description: who a request counts against: one part, or several for a composite key; default "ip"
